name: Decision 3.0
description: Live demo of the d3 decision models: decision.vllm-sr.ai

paragraphs: The official Space of Decision 3.0, the multimodal decision models of vLLM Semantic Router, live on the free API. It opens on d3. Ask Choice, Yes / No and Score questions about text, images and video and read the probability of every answer. On d3 and d3-flash, Box questions find something in an image: one box and its confidence, grid-scored (65 yes / no sub-questions on a zooming grid). Compare the two models side by side, with their latency. Every run, the examples included, is a live request to the free Decision API at decision.vllm-sr.ai: nothing is precomputed.
